technology_name: Nutritious Bamboo-based Food Products: Shoot Powder and Flakes
problem_solved: High perishability, short harvest windows, and cyanogenic toxicity of fresh bamboo shoots limit their culinary adoption and commercial utilization.
description: Standardized processing protocols to convert fresh, highly perishable bamboo shoots into shelf-stable, safe, and nutrient-dense food products: bamboo shoot powder and freeze-dried flakes. The process removes naturally occurring cyanogenic compounds to ensure safety. The powder can be blended into traditional staple recipes (breads, biscuits), while the freeze-dried flakes leverage lyophilization technology (sublimation under vacuum) to preserve original flavor, texture, and nutritional integrity while significantly extending shelf life.
applications:
• Commercial food processing and manufacturing (bakery, snacks, functional foods)

• Production of shelf-stable health supplements and high-fiber nutritional additives

• Rural entrepreneurship and local value-addition setups near bamboo harvesting clusters

• Supply chain sourcing for modern culinary and packaged food industries
secondary_sector: Biotechnology & Life Sciences, Consumer & Lifestyle Products, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
